# Teague

Shared basic functions and utils

## Setup

Install using pip, i.e. `pip install /path/to/this/dir`, or editable with `pip install -e`.

## Tools

### Looking Glass

Viewer for captures and calibration files.

Basic Usage (where `/path/to/your/data` shound contain the `calibration_dome.json`)
```
looking_glass /path/to/your/data
```
